title: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique
question: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021?

prediction.sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT p.segment,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year=2020 THEN s.product_code END) AS c2020,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year=2021 THEN s.product_code END) AS c2021
  FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
  JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code=p.product_code
  WHERE s.fiscal_year IN (2020,2021)
  GROUP BY p.segment
)
SELECT segment, c2020 AS unique_product_count_2020
FROM c
ORDER BY (c2021-c2020)*100.0/c2020 DESC;
